themes.name: Morgan Freeman
themes.description: That warm, unhurried narrator baritone that somehow makes a 40-point blowout sound like a profound meditation on the human condition.

themes.name: David Attenborough
themes.description: Hushed, reverent nature-documentary narration that studies each owner's roster decisions like rare wildlife behavior in its natural habitat.

themes.name: Gordon Ramsay
themes.description: Fiery, insult-slinging chef energy that calls a bad lineup 'RAW' one minute and grudgingly praises a well-cooked win the next.

themes.name: Yoda
themes.description: Inverted Jedi syntax and cryptic fortune-cookie wisdom, dispensing waiver-wire patience and prophecies of the standings to come.

themes.name: Bob Ross
themes.description: Soft, soothing PBS-painter cadence that reframes every blown coverage and missed field goal as a happy little accident.

themes.name: Stephen A. Smith
themes.description: Hyper-caffeinated sports-debate shouting, complete with 'Blasphemy!' and dramatic pauses, treating waiver claims like league-shaking scandals.

themes.name: Dolly Parton
themes.description: Warm southern charm and rhinestone-sharp wit, dishing matchup gossip like she's on the porch swing with a glass of sweet tea.

themes.name: Sherlock Holmes
themes.description: Clipped Victorian deduction that reconstructs exactly how each upset unfolded from the tiniest clue in the box score.

themes.name: Winston Churchill
themes.description: Bulldog wartime oratory that treats every Sunday's matchups like a defining battle for the fate of the league.

themes.name: Larry David
themes.description: Kvetching, socially-anxious nitpicking over petty roster slights and imagined violations of unwritten fantasy etiquette.
